Agent Name: Validation_Expert
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The validator adopted a flawed method by searching for the keyword "Thomas Aquinas" in revision comments/content and treating the first match (from a reverse-chronological, limited set) as the first image addition. This misuses the data (Rule 2) by conflating text mentions with image inclusion and ignoring revision order, anchoring subsequent reasoning on a wrong timestamp. As the first substantive misuse that set the path toward the incorrect date, it is the most responsible step (Rule 3).
